items.title: AASHOOR KI RAAT
items.body:
Aashoor ki Wo raat Wo sannaate ka aalam
Fitrat ki khamoshi me farishton ka Wo maatam
Soya hua ran me Asadullah ka zaiGham
Aur khoon me dooba hua Islaam ka parcham
<<MINI>>
Abbas tujhe Ahle Wafa yaad karenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekhi na gayi bachon ki jab tashna dahani
Aankhon me khatakne lagi maojo'n ki rawani
Paani ke liye apna lahu kar diya paani
Bachpan pa Sakina ke fida kardi jawani
<<MINI>>
Abbas tujhe Ahle Wafa yaad karenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Qabze me thi talwaar ke qabze meKhudaai
Do haath chali thi ke taraai nazar aayi
Bhai ki wigha door se dekha kiye Bhai
Yu Shaane Wafa Tu ne wafadaar dikhaai
<<MINI>>
Abbas tujhe Ahle Wafa yaad karenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Fatima Zehra ke qamar nayyare taaba'n
Baazue Hussain Ibne Ali naasire Ima'n
Khaaliq ki qasam kardiya Islaam pa ehsaan
Aye mashke Sakina ke Muhafiz Tere qurbaan
<<MINI>>
Abbas tujhe Ahle Wafa yaad karenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Duniya se gaya Shaan Wafaaon ki dikha kar
Paani na piya pyaasa raha nehr pa jaa kar
Ghode se gira khaakh pa baazu ko kata kar
Soya bhi to soyi hui millat ko jaga kar
<<MINI>>
Abbas tujhe Ahle Wafa yaad karenge
<<DIVIDER>>
Kazim koi karta hai to karne do bahana
Goonjega fazaaon me wafaaon ka taraana
Har rang me dhal jaaega ye Gham ka fasaana
Fitrat to na badlegi badal jaay zamana
<<MINI>>
Abbas tujhe Ahle Wafa yaad karenge
items.author: Kazim Banarsi

items.title: ZAINAB SE KARBALA KA ZARA MAAJRA SUNO
items.body:
Beti Ali ki Turbat e Zehra pa aayi hai
Kurta lahu bhara hua Bhai ka laayi hai
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
AmmaHamare ranjo masa'eb hai dardnaak
AmmaHamare qalbo jigar ho chuke hain chaak
AmmaHamare Nana ki ummat ne ki dagha
AmmaHamare khoon ko samjhe hain sab rawa'n
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
Amma taras ke reh gaye paani ko Ham tamam
Amma diya na Ham ko Kisi ne bhi ek jam
AmmaHamare mard tahe tegh hogaye
Amma naha ke khoon me bechare sogaye
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
Amma pade hain nehr pa Abbas rooth kar
Amma Sakina soti hai zinda'n me be Pidar
Amma kahan se Akbar e mehru ko laaun Main
Amma kahan se Asghar e nadaa'n ko paaun me
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
Amma Habib Ibne Mazahir zohair eQain
Kaam aagaye hain wo bhi be Nusrat e Hussain
Amma wo Hur ke jis ne sar apna kata diya
Naqshe kafe Hussain me Eema ko pa liya
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
Amma Hussain Karbobala hi me reh gaye
Amma Hussain saare masa'eb ko seh gaye
Amma Hussain Margaye beyaar o bewatan
Amma Hussain ko na mayaasar huwa kafan
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
AmmaHamari chaderin bhi chhin gayi tamam
AmmaHamare haal pa hanste the ahle shaam
Amma wo shaam e ghurbat e Shabbir aah aah
Amma wo raat kaali wo sunsaan qatl gaah
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
Amma ye haal Abid e Beemar hogaya
Zaalim sipah ne le liya bistar ghareeb ka
Amma qadam qadam pa aseeri rula gayi
Gardan me tauq paaun me zanjeer aagayi
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
Amma wo Bibiyo'n ka tadapna wo shoro shain
Amma rahegi yaad wo aaho buka ke bain
Amma Rabab Roti hai Asghar ko sub'ho shaam
Akbar ko yaad karti hai Laila tashna kaam
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
Baazu keneel dekhiye AmmaKhuda gawah
Maqtal ki gard ban gayi afsha'n Khuda gawah
Amma ye bebasi ye qayamat ki bebasi
AmmaHamare haal pa Roti hai bekasi
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
<<DIVIDER>>
Ammabataaaiye to Main ab jeeke kya karun
Kis tarha ab Hussain ki furqat ka Gham sahu'n
Aayi Fugha'n nida ke sare hashr Ham bhi ab
Kurta lahu bhara hua rakh denge peshe Rab
Beti Tumhara Bhai Shahe Mashragqain hai
Beti Tumhare sabr me Fath'he Hussain hai
<<MINI>>
Kehti hai Aye Hussain ki AmmaUthoUtho
Zainab se Karbala ka zara maajra suno
